rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is mainly or chiefly the case.

example.english: This plan is principally intended to improve elderly people's lives.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃主要係為咗改善老人家嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 wai6 zo2 goi2 sin6 lou5 jan4 gaa1 ge3 saang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that most of the items, people, time, or amount are involved.

example.english: The audience was principally made up of students.
example.traditional: 現場大部分觀眾都係學生。
example.jyutping: jin6 coeng4 daai6 bou6 fan6 gun1 zung3 dou1 hai6 hok6 saang1

rows.note: Use this when identifying the main component, type, or group that predominates.

example.english: This restaurant's menu is principally seafood.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅菜式以海鮮為主。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 ji5 hoi2 sin1 wai4 zyu2
